request.style: English, male soprano solo with gentle choir, harp, soft flute, piano, cello, ethereal and reverent, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Seth lived one hundred and five
Then he saw a son arrive
He named him Enosh, pure and true
Into the line where faith grew

[Verse]
At that time the people found
A way to make their hearts sound
They began to call aloud
On the name of the Lord

[Verse]
When Enosh was ninety years old
He fathered Kenan, as told
Eight hundred and fifteen more
He lived, keeping faith to the core

[Verse]
Other sons and daughters came
In the name they bore the same
From Adam down to Seth’s line
Enosh stands in grace divine

[Verse]
Luke lists him in the chain
The son of Enosh, plain and plain
Son of Seth, son of Adam’s seed
From God, the story is read

[Outro]
Calling on the name of the Lord
